messages.subject: Pennington v Crossfield — costs schedule for the CCMC
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Quick one on the OTHER Pennington matter — Pennington v Crossfield Engineering. The court has listed the costs management hearing and we need our Precedent H in by 16 February. I've drafted it based on the budget Harriet Stanford approved; the contingent trial-prep phase looks high so I'll trim it before it goes to the client. Nothing to do with the CMA work, just flagging so it doesn't slip while we're heads-down on Forge.

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
